description: Given a discount-points / lender-credit tradeoff menu for a candidate loan, returns break-even months, lifetime savings, and the optimal point-spend. The points analog of refinance_break_even.

base_rate.description: The no-points (par) interest rate, percent, e.g. 6.75.

hold_months.description: Expected time-in-loan horizon for lifetime savings; defaults to term_months.

points.description: Discount points as % of loan (positive) or lender credit (negative); 1 = 1% of loan.

rate.description: Resulting interest rate at that point spend, percent.

name: optimize_buydown

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs filled in because the caller did not supply them, notably the holding period that decides the winner.

hold_months.description: Holding period in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

base_monthly_payment.description: Monthly principal-and-interest payment in dollars at the base rate.

base_rate.description: The no-points starting rate as a percent string, the baseline every option is measured against.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

hold_months.description: How long the borrower is assumed to keep the loan. Buying points only wins if this exceeds the option's break-even.

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in dollars as a formatted string; point costs are a percentage of this.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

optimal.description: The option that maximizes net savings over the assumed holding period.

break_even_months.description: Months to recover the winning option's point cost.

point_cost.description: Upfront cost in dollars of the winning option.

points.description: Points bought in the winning option.

rate.description: Rate as a percent string in the winning option.

savings_over_hold.description: Net dollars the winning option saves over the assumed holding period.

why.description: One-sentence justification of the winning option, safe to quote.

options.description: Each points/rate combination modeled, including negative points (lender credits) where supplied.

break_even_months.description: Months for the monthly savings to repay the point cost. 0 on the baseline option, since nothing was spent.

lifetime_interest.description: Total interest in dollars over the full term at this rate, ignoring the hold period.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly principal-and-interest payment in dollars at this option's rate.

monthly_savings.description: Dollars per month saved versus the base rate; $0 on the baseline option.

point_cost.description: Upfront cost in dollars for these points, as a formatted string.

points.description: Points bought, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount. Negative values are lender credits that raise the rate in exchange for cash at closing.

rate.description: Note rate as a percent string after this buydown.

savings_over_hold.description: Net dollars saved over hold_months after paying for the points; this is the figure to compare across options.

reason.description: Why no buydown option was recommended, present only in that case — e.g. 'No option produces positive net savings over the hold horizon; paying par (no points) is best.'

recommendation.description: The action implied by the analysis, e.g. 'buy_points', 'no_points', or 'take_credit'.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (360 = 30 years, 180 = 15 years, 60 = 5 years).
